title: Cinematic Pack
description: A modpack aiming to make Minecraft very cinematic while only adding as few of new blocks as possible and beating the game pretty much like vanilla.
body:
"As a child i yearned for the mines..." -Steve
Don't worry there is nothing related to the Minecraft Movie in this modpack.

This modpack is for making Minecraft really **cinematic** and **immersive** while only adding a few blocks, keeping it **almost vanilla**. It almost looks like Skyrim with all those realistic mods or something.

This is also my first public modpack but i put alot of work into this to make sure the performance is good while looking incredible.

Important Note: This Modpack is not for weak computers!!! Though the performace is good it still will not run very well on potato computers! The recommended GPU would be a NVIDIA Geforce RTX 3060. If you want to run it on any computer with a less powerful GPU, then i would say turn off the shaders or Voxy.

This pack wouldn't be made if this video didn't exist.
